name: Base ERC-4337 Paymaster Gas Sponsorship
role: LegioX truth lens — Ring Base L2 secondary rail

mission.primary_objective: Sponsor Base L2 gas for Ring US users via CDP Paymaster and ERC-4337 smart accounts so RING mirror transfers and desk ops execute without users holding ETH.
mission.context: Unlike Solana native feePayer, Base sponsorship requires account abstraction — EOAs must upgrade to smart accounts (CDP embedded wallet, EIP-7702, or Base Account). CDP Paymaster is ERC-7677: bundler + paymaster unified endpoint on Base Mainnet and Sepolia only.
mission.target_outcome: useCdpPaymaster or wallet_sendCalls with paymasterService; RING mirror + desk contracts allowlisted in CDP portal; server proxy protects API key; per-user and global spend caps.
mission.scope: Base paymaster integration for ring-platform.org Phase 1.5. Excludes Solana feePayer (solana-fee-sponsorship-native) and Polygon legacy gas.

truth_lens: ERC-4337 Paymasters sponsor gas only for smart accounts — plain EOAs cannot use CDP Paymaster without upgrade. Ring allowlists RING mirror transfer and RingSales desk selectors in CDP portal — deny by default. CDP_PAYMASTER_URL is server-only; Next.js API route proxies with Auth.js session check and rate limits. Base fees are sub-cent but sponsorship removes ETH onboarding friction for US Coinbase funnel users.
core_principles: Smart account required — document EIP-7702 vs CDP embedded path.
Contract allowlist per function selector in CDP portal.
Server proxy only — never NEXT_PUBLIC paymaster URL.
Per-user and global dollar caps on sponsorship spend.
Solana canonical supply — paymaster does not mint RING.
anti_patterns: Claiming gasless EOA transfers without AA upgrade.
Exposing CDP API key in client bundles or env NEXT_PUBLIC_*.
Unallowlisted contract calls burning sponsorship budget.
Using Base paymaster patterns for Solana feePayer (different model).
Sponsoring unbounded delegatecall or arbitrary contract writes.
key_patterns: useSendUserOperation({ paymaster: true }) with CDP provider.
CDP portal: allowlist RING.transfer, RingSales.buy/sell selectors.
POST /api/base/paymaster proxy: session + rate limit + CDP forward.
Handle paymaster limit exceeded → user-friendly fallback message.
Base Sepolia for integration tests before mainnet allowlist.
consult_when: Implementing gasless RING transfer on Base smart accounts.
Building server paymaster proxy with Auth.js.
Choosing CDP embedded wallet vs wagmi + AA adapter.
Debugging paymaster rejection vs insufficient ETH on non-AA wallet.
